caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular flower box sitting on a patch of brown and green ground, with grass-like details, set against a background of light blue sky. The flower box is white with red vertical stripes and features a central plaque bordered with green leaves; inside the plaque, the text "Eliza Hunter 1798" is written in cursive script. A variety of flowers and leaves extend above and around the box. The flowers include different shapes, with petals colored in shades of pink, red, blue, purple, and brown, and most feature shaded detail or striping. The leaves are mostly green, some with a hint of brown, depicted in multiple sizes and extending from thin, dark green stems. Some flowers have detailed, circular, or spiral centers, and several leaves and flower stems emerge around the base of the box and extend outward in different directions. The entire drawing is enclosed within a thin brown border on a cream-colored paper background.
title: Embroidered Picture
